detail.longDescription: Most Kubernetes clusters are running cluster-admin bindings that started as "temporary." Temporary three years ago. Wrote up how to find them and fix them without breaking prod, for Teleport: https:// goteleport.com/blog/how-to-red uce-overprivileged-kubernetes-service-accounts/ What's the oldest "temporary" RBAC workaround still running in your environment? # security # kubernetes
